# SAHTA

> SAHTA is the Andalusian Society for Hypertension and Vascular Risk, providing clinical guidelines, member resources, and continuing education for healthcare professionals in cardiovascular medicine.

SAHTA serves as a medical association dedicated to advancing knowledge and practice in hypertension management and cardiovascular risk assessment across Andalusia, Spain. The organization facilitates clinical education through case studies, guidelines, and professional networking events.

## Key Topics

- Hypertension
- Cardiovascular Risk
- Clinical Cases
- Medical Guidelines
- Patient Resources
- Andalusia Health
- Medical Association

## Core Portal

- [SAHTA Homepage](https://sahta.com): SAHTA main portal with clinical cases, guidelines, and member resources for hypertension and cardiovascular risk management
- [SAHTA Main Site](https://www.sahta.com/index.php): SAHTA main site with patient resources and cardiovascular risk guidelines
- [SAHTA Index](https://sahta.com/index.php): SAHTA portal featuring clinical cases, guidelines, and comprehensive member resources

## Professional Development

- [XVIII ENCUENTRO DE RESIDENTES DE LA SAHTA SEVILLA 2026](https://residentes.sahta.com/index.php): 2026 SAHTA residents meeting in Sevilla for hypertension and diabetes cases, providing continuing education and clinical training
